title: 第3章 不能做外族人罐头哪只能腌制或者碳烤保存了第4章 领地的发展
slug: 领主反派破灭后开始当战犯
content_zh:
“主人，我来给您治疗。”莉莉姆之前身为伪系统，其实也算是个系统，爱神给出去的东西大部分都使用不了，但还是有魔法能使用。
【魔法.治疗】
“我伤的不重，先去治疗其他人，该止血的止血，改用魔法消毒的消毒。”林恩抓住莉莉姆的手放在一名重伤的民兵身上，这个民兵算好的了，躲闪及时，只被砍去了一条手臂，还是在战斗的尾声，这才没有立刻死亡。
不同于其他普通的魔法治疗术，来自爱神赐予书籍教导的治疗效果十分的好，但也只是表面上的。
说人话就是治疗效果能让人亢奋，类似于古老的止痛药，疼是止住了，但也有幻觉，说人话就是爽了。
要说真正的治疗效果，那只是说包含了消毒，止疼，以及加速修复身体而已，原本可以要修养一百天，使用后只需要修养五十天，可以说是很有用的魔法了。
原本是为了让黄毛能应付多个目标的魔法。
用在伤势上效果十分显着。
只看见原本脸上痛苦无比的士兵逐渐露出享受的表情，士兵不可置信道：“太不可思议了，莉莉姆大人。”
莉莉姆十分用心的治疗人们，赢得了众人的青睐。
艾克雷看着这个来历不明，林恩成男爵才突然出现的家伙，以为是少爷，啊不，现在应该是老爷了。
还以为是老爷的癖好是喜欢小女孩呢，现在看来这个小女孩也不简单啊，这治疗术比一般的修女还要厉害啊。
简直就是圣女亲临，要是没有那副猫亚人的特征的话，她说自己是圣女没有人不会相信。
唯一有点诟病的就是莉莉姆的治疗特效是粉红色的。
有点像红灯区的魔法。
莉莉姆在治疗，林恩也没闲着。
试问一句话，一个人的思维转变需要多久？
答案是一瞬间。
林恩的心态现在已经从玩当二游男主转成发展国家意识形态了。
个人，是有私心，有道德感的。

p社玩家没有，一切都是为了效率。
林恩真正计算得失。
骑士们没有什么伤亡，有的养几天就能好，民兵们我当填线师用了，有点惨烈，40人只剩下十几个了，一半都是缺胳膊少腿的。
因为打架粮食还散落一地，需要收拾。
（此处已修改。）
“有谁会保存肉？”
这个制作时间很长，需要12个小时，加上30多头牛，实在太多了，没办法的林恩只能先把这些肉带走，新鲜的肉可以保存三到五天，林恩使用还用魔法变出冰块进行保存。
做完这一切后。
林恩突然想起要紧的事情，急忙从自己本就不多的金库里拿出钱财：“骑士们，士兵们，为了奖励你们英勇作战，每人奖赏1金币！”
content_en:
"Master, let me treat you." Lilim used to be a pseudo-system, but it is actually a system. Most of the things given by the God of Love cannot be used, but there is still magic that can be used.
【Magic. Treatment】
"I'm not seriously injured. Let's go treat the others first. Stop the bleeding and use magic disinfection instead." Linn grabbed Lilim's hand and placed it on a seriously injured militiaman. The militiaman was fine. He dodged in time and only had one arm cut off. It was at the end of the battle, so he didn't die immediately.
Different from other ordinary magical healing techniques, the healing effect taught by the books given by the God of Love is very good, but it is only superficial.
Speaking in human words means that the therapeutic effect can make people excited, similar to ancient painkillers. The pain is stopped, but there are also hallucinations. Speaking in human words makes people feel good.
To talk about the real therapeutic effect, it only includes disinfection, pain relief, and accelerated body repair. It could have taken a hundred days to practice, but it only takes fifty days to practice after use. It can be said to be a very useful magic.
It was originally a magic that allowed Huang Mao to deal with multiple targets.
The effect is very significant when used on injuries.
The soldier who was originally in great pain gradually showed an expression of enjoyment. The soldier said in disbelief: "It's incredible, Lord Lilim."
Lilim treated people very carefully and won everyone's favor.
Aikeli looked at this guy whose origin was unknown and had just appeared suddenly as Baron Lin Encheng. He thought he was the young master, but no, he should be the master now.
I thought it was the master's hobby that he liked little girls. Now it seems that this little girl is not simple at all. Her healing skills are even more powerful than those of ordinary nuns.
It was like the saint was here in person. If she didn't have those cat-like features, no one would believe her when she said she was a saint.
The only criticism is that Lilim's healing effects are pink.
A bit like the magic of the red light district.
Lilim is undergoing treatment, and Linn is not idle either.
Let me ask you, how long does it take for a person's thinking to change?
The answer is a moment.
Lin En's mentality has now changed from playing as a second-game male protagonist to developing national ideology.
Individuals have selfish motives and a sense of morality.
There is no such thing as P club players, everything is for efficiency.
Lynn really counts the gains and losses.
There were no casualties among the knights, and some could recover after a few days of treatment. I used the militiamen as line fillers, which was a bit miserable. There were only a dozen or so of the 40 left, and half of them were missing arms and legs.
Because of the fight, food was still scattered all over the ground and needed to be cleaned up.
(This has been modified.)
“Who knows how to preserve meat?”
This production takes a long time, 12 hours, and with more than 30 cows, it is too much. Linn has no choice but to take the meat away first. The fresh meat can be stored for three to five days. Linn also used magic to conjure ice cubes for preservation.
After doing all this.
Lin En suddenly remembered something important and hurriedly took out the money from his small treasury: "Knights and soldiers, in order to reward you for your heroic battle, each of you will be rewarded with 1 gold coin!"
